description: This file contains a script for updating the changelog of the Excalidraw library by extracting commit information from git logs and formatting it into markdown.

methods.name: getCommitHashForLastVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the latest commit hash associated with the last release of the library.

methods.name: getLibraryCommitsSinceLastRelease
methods.description: Fetches commit messages since the last release and categorizes them by type.

methods.name: updateChangelog
methods.description: Generates and updates the changelog markdown file with new release information.
